content: OWASP ASVS 5.0 categories differ from old V2 auth/V5 validation numbering: V2 Validation and Business Logic, V5 File Handling, V6 Authentication, V7 Session Management, V8 Authorization, V11 Cryptography, V14 Data Protection. For on-device iOS use MASVS STORAGE, PLATFORM, CODE, PRIVACY as mobile mapping; imported file names are untrusted and file deletion must remain ownership-contained.
